text:
Alex: Heads-up — planning to unpin the default model next Wednesday. Quick Q: what should our backwards-compat grace window be and what fallback guarantees do we promise? cc @Maria @Sam
Maria: 2 weeks sounds safe for client teams to add `Accept-Model`. Do we have telemetry to measure who’s already sending it?
Sam: We do have a telemetry tag for `accept_model` header usage (last 30d). Current adoption is ~28% across active SDKs.
Sam: For older SDKs, server currently falls back to the current default model if header missing. That behavior is stable but will become a breaking change once we unpin.
Alex: OK. Proposal: 14-day grace period after the unpin rollout where server will: 1) honor `Accept-Model` if present, 2) if missing, continue serving previous default for 14d but log + surface counts. After 14d, unpinned default flips fully. Thoughts?
Maria: Fine by me, but add an explicit opt-out header for platforms that want strict behavior earlier (eg `Accept-Model: strict`). Also add a warning header in responses during grace: `X-Model-Warning: unpin-grace`
Sam: Agree — add `X-Model-Warning`. We should also publish a deprecation email to top 20 integrators at day 0 and a follow-up at day 7.
Jen: Ops question: can we canary the flip to 10% of traffic first? If any anomalies, rollback to pinned default.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: api-server v4.12 -> staging at 2026-04-07T22:00Z, canary -> prod 10% at 2026-04-09T03:00Z if health checks pass.
Alex: Nice. Can we add a flag gated by `model_unpin_rollout` to control the canary percent?
Sam: Yep, feature flag exists. I’ll add a `grace_mode` enum: `preserve_default`, `enforce_accept`, `strict`. Default during grace = `preserve_default`.
Alex: Snippet for docs + SDK teams to show header usage:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Accept-Model: gpt-like-v2" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
Maria: Also add an SDK compatibility shim: clients on old SDKs should receive a `warning` event in the SDK telemetry if they get a fallback response. That will help teams triage.
Jen: From infra side: set alert if error rate or latency deviates >2x during canary. Ops will auto-roll back at threshold.
Alex: Action items: Sam -> implement `X-Model-Warning` + flag enum; Jen -> canary + alerts; Maria -> comms to integrators + docs snippet; Me -> timeline + rollout email. Confirming 14-day grace window and 10% initial canary.
Sam: Working on PR now, will link in this thread.
Maria: I'll draft the integrator note and a short blog blurb.
Alex: Thanks — will post final rollout schedule tomorrow and tag owners. :thumbsup:
